scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "pnpm run dev:web" "pnpm run dev:api"
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm --filter @workspace/atc-website --filter @workspace/api-server --filter @workspace/scripts --if-present run typecheck
